attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

mcd15-1.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

mcd15-2.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

mcd15-3.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

mcd15-4.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

mcd15-5.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

mcd15-6.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

mcd15-7.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

mcd15-8.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

mcd15-9.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

mcd15-10.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

mcd15-11.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

mcd15-12.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
